responsibility: This header defines the macro defaults and aggregate initializer for GCC’s lang_hooks structure, which front ends use to describe language-specific behavior to the shared compiler core. It maps each language hook slot to either a default helper from langhooks.cc/hooks.cc or a null entry, covering options processing, diagnostics, declarations, types, gimplification, OpenMP handling, builtin registration, dumping, LTO section output, and many other frontend integration points, and finally assembles them into LANG_HOOKS_INITIALIZER for use by individual languages.
